input_vintage: Existing frozen scientific_strengthening_20261005 annual pairs and native balances
growth_scaling: Scale the complete incremental candidate path and its specified associated response by one common nonnegative factor; hold resources, no-new-growth background and association rates fixed. No retuning or realized-capacity interpretation.
unknown_or_infeasible: A negative no-new-growth balance in any year makes all-year attainment infeasible at every nonnegative factor. A zero pressure slope with a nonnegative background has no finite algebraic upper bound, not unlimited physical capacity.
scenario_counts: Descriptive counts in a pre-specified grid, not probabilities or independent observations.
scope: Derived results only; frozen inputs, historical methods and scores, canonical plots and older manuscripts must remain unchanged.
